WITH race_totals AS (
  SELECT 
    r.name,
    SUM(res.points) as total_points
  FROM races r
  JOIN results res ON r.raceId = res.raceId
  GROUP BY r.name
),
average_total AS (
  SELECT AVG(total_points) as avg_total
  FROM race_totals
)
SELECT 
  (
    SELECT SUM(rt.total_points)
    FROM race_totals rt
    CROSS JOIN average_total at
    WHERE rt.total_points > at.avg_total
  ) as combined_total_points,
  (
    SELECT AVG(CAST(res.laps AS FLOAT))
    FROM results res
    JOIN races r ON res.raceId = r.raceId
    JOIN race_totals rt ON r.name = rt.name
    CROSS JOIN average_total at
    WHERE rt.total_points > at.avg_total
  ) as average_laps_completed,
  (
    SELECT AVG(rt.total_points - at.avg_total)
    FROM race_totals rt
    CROSS JOIN average_total at
    WHERE rt.total_points > at.avg_total
  ) as average_excess
